items.source: Calling this method sets the ExpressionMarker as in-use.
items.translation: 调用此方法会将ExpressionMarker标记为in-use。

items.source: ExpressionMarker is intended to be used via AotQueryMethodGenerationContext to maintain usage info, making sure the code is only added (isInUse()) when enclosingMethod() was called for generating code.
items.translation: ExpressionMarker 旨在通过 AotQueryMethodGenerationContext 使用，以维护使用情况信息，确保仅在调用 enclosingMethod() 生成代码时才会添加该代码（isInUse()）。

items.source: if the marker is in use.

ExpressionMarker is used to add a dedicated type to AOT generated methods that can be used to determine the current method by calling Class.getEnclosingMethod() on it. This can be useful when working with expressions (eg. SpEL) that need to be evaluated in a given context.
items.translation: ExpressionMarker 用于为 AOT 生成的方法添加专用类型，以便通过调用 Class.getEnclosingMethod() 来确定当前方法。这在需要结合特定上下文评估表达式（例如 SpEL）时非常有用。

items.source:
ExpressionMarker marker = context.getExpressionMarker();
CodeBlock.builder().add("evaluate($L, $S, $L)", marker.enclosingMethod(), queryString, parameters);
items.translation:
ExpressionMarker marker = context.getExpressionMarker();
CodeBlock.builder().add("evaluate($L, $S, $L)", marker.enclosingMethod(), queryString, parameters);
